title: The Card Sharp (character)
description:
[h2]The Card Sharp: a new playable character[/h2]
A sly gambler who plays poker with her own deck. Every card has a [b]rank and suit[/b]; cards you play are laid on the [b]Table[/b], and at five cards a [b]Showdown[/b] deals damage based on the best poker hand.

HP 68. Starting relic: Marked Deck. 87 cards.

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay: everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the same version.
[*]Requires BaseLib (subscribed automatically as a required item).
[*]Personal fan project, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
[/list]
changeNote: v0.4.0 balance update: the Pot (each Showdown +2 damage, up to +7); High card to Two pair hit one random enemy, Three of a kind and up hit ALL; Showdowns add your Strength. Cold Deck, Pit Boss, High Stakes/High Roller, Card Shark reworked. New: 5 relics (incl. Stacked Deck from the Ancients) and 3 potions.
